expectations.text: [3.1] A cache port interface is declared beside its adapter under server/src/adapters/ and NOT pushed into the client-mirrored vendor/shared/adapters.ts
expectations.evidence: cache port declared beside its adapter in server/src/adapters/cache/index.ts
expectations.rule: Where does the port interface go?

expectations.text: [3.2] The Redis client is constructed only inside server/src/adapters/ — no `new Redis(...)` in a service, repository, or route
expectations.evidence: Redis client is constructed only inside adapters/
expectations.rule: Hard rule 3 — no direct SDK construction outside an adapter

expectations.text: [3.3] The cache is resolved from platform/container.ts and has a ContainerOverrides slot so tests can swap it
expectations.evidence: container resolves the cache and exposes a ContainerOverrides slot
expectations.rule: Hard rule 6 — compose only at the root

expectations.text: [3.4] The caller codes against the cache port, not against Redis types (no ioredis/Redis import outside adapters/)
expectations.evidence: callers code against the port, not Redis types
expectations.rule: Hard rule 1 — the inside codes against the port

expectations.text: [3.5] The Redis connection string comes from config/env, not a hardcoded literal
